info.title: PHPYun API v1
info.description:
PHPYun WAP API v1 (stable)

---

## 开发环境快捷登录

uid=1, 30 年 TTL。把对应角色的 token 放进 `Authorization: Bearer …`。

**admin**:
```
eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJzdWIiOjEsInVzZXJ0eXBlIjozLCJkaWQiOjAsImlhdCI6MTc4ODQyOTE2MSwiZXhwIjoyNzM0NTA5MTYxLCJqdGkiOiJkZXYtdG9rZW4tanRpLXYxLWFjY2Vzcy11MyIsInR5cCI6ImFjY2VzcyJ9.yplChSmHDyBfa9qFajAX5LQALcvc9q0RyzNnsrkljOg
```

**jobseeker**:
```
eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJzdWIiOjEsInVzZXJ0eXBlIjoxLCJkaWQiOjAsImlhdCI6MTc4ODQyOTE2MSwiZXhwIjoyNzM0NTA5MTYxLCJqdGkiOiJkZXYtdG9rZW4tanRpLXYxLWFjY2Vzcy11MSIsInR5cCI6ImFjY2VzcyJ9.bLe0TwuWMf_ERXZwFuQO9GXYMhRJztDVrQmRop5ngBo
```

**employer**:
```
eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJzdWIiOjEsInVzZXJ0eXBlIjoyLCJkaWQiOjAsImlhdCI6MTc4ODQyOTE2MSwiZXhwIjoyNzM0NTA5MTYxLCJqdGkiOiJkZXYtdG9rZW4tanRpLXYxLWFjY2Vzcy11MiIsInR5cCI6ImFjY2VzcyJ9.uaxF8LzvY2x7-hP0cvOdoaTGG7AQK4zxuprAEgkWsPo
```

JSON 接口取 token: [`GET /dev/token`](/dev/token)（仅测试环境返回）。

post.summary:
Splits the current personal account into an independent new account — all jobseeker data
(resumes/favorites/applications/registrations etc.) have their uid batch-updated to the new
account's uid; if the original account is also a company, the original account's usertype is
changed to 2 to retain the company identity.
post.description: This operation runs inside a single MySQL transaction; if any sub-UPDATE fails everything is rolled back.

parameters.name: slot
parameters.description:
Slot key — alphanumeric / underscore / hyphen, 1..=64 chars. The
string flows into `phpyun_ad.slot = ?`, so a stricter charset guard
(vs. plain length) removes any chance of control characters / spaces
reaching the DB and keeps slot keys URL-safe.

post.summary:
Record an ad click. Counterpart of PHP `index/index::clickhits_action`.
Per-IP rate limit window is read from `sy_adclick` (hours); a 0 / unset
value disables the rate limit.

Get the latest version for a platform
Public article detail (hits +1 in async background)

Counterpart of PHP `category::getHotJobClass(rec=1)` powering homepage

Confirm a pending email change. Body carries the one-time token (so it
never appears in URLs, access logs, or browser history).
Public company list (filter by keyword / region / industry)

parameters.name: keyword
parameters.description: Matched against `name` AND `shortname` via LIKE (mirrors PHP `comlist`).

post.summary:
Lightweight company name autocomplete — counterpart of PHP
`ajax::getComBySearch_action`. Designed for typeahead widgets, returns up
to `limit` rows (clamped to 1..=20) where `name` matches `LIKE %keyword%`.

parameters.name: keyword
parameters.description:

Uses an INNER JOIN on `phpyun_hotjob` × `phpyun_company`, filtered by
`c.hottime > now AND c.r_status = 1 AND h.time_start < now AND h.time_end > now`.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description:
`default` (paid sort, ASC), `recent` (job lastupdate DESC), `random`.

Track a download click — counterpart of PHP `hr/index::ajax_action`.
Atomically `downnum +=1` then returns the file URL so the client can
redirect (PHP echoes `checkpic($row['url'])` directly; we wrap in JSON).

Public job endpoint with two modes:
- **Detail mode**: when the body carries `id`, returns the same rich
  shape as `/v1/wap/jobs/detail` (`{job, company, dict, user_context,
  msg_list, formatted}`).
- **List mode**: when `id` is absent, returns the paginated browse list
  (`{list, total, page, page_size}`).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description:
When provided, `/v1/wap/jobs` returns the **detail** of a single job
instead of the paginated list — same endpoint, two response shapes.

parameters.name: keyword
parameters.description:
Free-text search; capped at 100 chars to keep LIKE plans sane and
guard against memory-exhaustion via 10MB-keyword requests.

parameters.name: report
parameters.description: Salary cycle dict id — 月薪/年薪/时薪 (PHP `report`).

parameters.name: welfare
parameters.description:
Welfare dict id (PHP `welfare`). Resolved to the dict name before
running `welfare LIKE '%<name>%'` against the CSV-encoded column.

parameters.name: uptime
parameters.description: Refresh-time bucket in days (1, 3, 7, 30, 90 are PHPYun's UI options).

parameters.name: urgent
parameters.description: `urgent=true` keeps only postings whose `urgent_time` hasn't expired.

parameters.name: uid
parameters.description: Company uid — company profile “open jobs” list.

post.summary:
Resolve the contact info for a single job. Counterpart of PHP
`app/job/comapply::getJobLink_action` / `gettel_action`.
Plaintext tel is returned only when `setCompanyLink` yields `linkCode=1`.
Email is never included (PC comapply.htm does not display it).
Public job detail -- returned as a nested map **grouped by business concern**.
post.description:
Response structure:
- `job`: job main-table fields passed through (field names match DB columns, e.g. `provinceid` / `minsalary` / `zp_num`)
- `company`: company-related fields (`logo` / `provinceid` / `cityid` / `hy` / `linkman` / `linktel` / ...)
- `dict`: dictionary translations (`job_one/two/three` / `jobname` / `hy_n` / `welfare_names` / `langname` / `city_one/two`)
- `user_context`: counters tied to the currently logged-in user (all 0 when not logged in)
- `msg_list`: latest 5 job inquiries
- `formatted`: display-ready formatted strings (timestamps, average salary)

post.summary:
Soft-delete a one-off recruitment. Counterpart of the legacy
`{password, status:2}` update body; password is verified against the
row's stored hash.

Create a payment order for a one-off shop posting — counterpart of PHP
`wap/once::getOrder_action`. The downstream gateway redirect (alipay /
wxpay) is **not** performed here; the front-end uses `order_id` + the

400.description: Invalid gear / wrong password / once-job not found

post.summary:
Update a one-off recruitment. Body must satisfy `UpsertBody` validation
(every field length / range checked before any DB code runs). Soft-delete
has been split out to its dedicated route — see
`POST /v1/wap/once-jobs/{id}/delete`.

parameters.name: rec
parameters.description:
`rec=true` keeps only sticky/promoted listings (mirrors PHP partlist
`rec_time > now`).

post.summary: Apply for a part-time job (job seeker)
Gateway callback: authenticate via the shared secret in the `X-Pay-Token` header -> mark-paid

Composition spec: kind in `job`/`company`/`gongzhao`. `invite-reg` does not go through here,
because the id parameter has a different meaning (inviter uid instead of resource id); use the dedicated `/me` endpoint.

parameters.name: hb
parameters.description: Optional: specify the template id; if omitted, use the default template (highest sort/num under the same kind)

parameters.name: uid
parameters.description: "Promoter uid" used when not logged in; ignored when logged in

post.summary: Hot questions of the week (aligned with PHP `wap/ask::hotweek_action`)

Top answerers in the last N days — counterpart of PHP
`ask::getAnswersList(groupby:uid, orderby:num)` powering the "热门回答者"
sidebar on `ask/topic` and `ask/search` pages.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description:
Lookback window in days (1..=365). PHP hard-codes 30; we expose it for
flexibility but default to the same value.

post.summary:
Sliding-session refresh: pass the **current valid** access_token via the
standard `Authorization: Bearer ...` header, get back a new access_token
with extended expiry. The old token's jti is added to the blacklist
immediately so it cannot be reused.
post.description:
Trade-off vs. classic refresh-token flow: a leaked access_token can be
rotated indefinitely until manual revocation, but the client never has
to manage a second long-lived secret.

- No params: all countries (level=0), sorted by name.
- `?country=CN`: every active node under that country (every level).
- `?country=CN&level=1`: just the state/province layer of that country.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (CN/US/JP/...). When supplied the result is restricted to that country.

post.summary: Single node by stable code (recommended for client-side references).
Direct children of a node — used by cascading dropdowns.

Resolve a `(lng, lat)` to the configured sub-site domain — counterpart of
PHP `wap/index::getCityDomain_action`.
post.description:
Multi-site mode is not yet wired in Rust (needs Baidu Maps reverse-geocoding
+ the `phpyun_domain` table); this endpoint always returns `error: 2`,
which matches PHP's "sub-site disabled" branch and lets clients render the
fall-through state without 404s.

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: Longitude (Baidu BD-09 coordinates, matches PHP `wap/index::getCityDomain` `x` param)

post.summary: Account registration (SMS + image captcha + auto login)

400.description: Invalid parameter / invalid captcha / field taken

post.summary: Pre-registration check: whether a given username / mobile / email is already taken.
post.description:
**Note**: this endpoint leaks "whether the account exists" information and is for the registration page only.
Do not call it from login or password-recovery flows.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description:
Value to check (an email / mobile / username). Hard-capped at 128 chars
to avoid hashing or LIKE-scanning a 1MB blob.

post.summary: Registration rules config: clients can use this for instant validation and display copy.

View a resume via a one-time share token. Token goes in the JSON body so
it never appears in URLs / access logs / browser history.
Public resume list — guests may browse (PHP `wap/resume`); contacts stay off this payload.

Resolve a jobseeker's default `phpyun_resume_expect.id` from their uid.
Counterpart of PHP `wap/resume/index::showuid_action`, which uses this
for the `/resume/show?uid=...` redirect. Returns `0` when the resume is

Public resume detail — guests may read the body; contact fields follow

Bump the per-job-intent hit count on a resume. Counterpart of PHP
`app/resume/show::GetHits_action`. PHP optionally inflates by a random
`sy_job_hits` factor; we bump by exactly 1 here. The `eid` parameter is
`phpyun_resume_expect.id` (job-intent row id), not the resume `uid`.

parameters.name: kw
parameters.description:
Free-text search; capped at 100 chars and required (empty `kw`
returns 400 instead of running an unbounded LIKE).

post.summary: Public resume share link (non-token version — login required to view)

Front-end map widget configuration. Counterpart of PHP
`ajax::mapconfig_action` — bundles every `map_*` site setting into one
JSON payload so the client doesn't have to issue 8 setting requests.

List public settings, or return selectable report reasons when
`key=report_reasons`.

200.description: Public settings, or report reason options for report_reasons

post.summary:
List configured sub-sites. PHP equivalent: `wap/site::cache_action`
(the raw `phpyun_domain` rows behind the legacy `cron.cache.php`
pre-baked dump).

parameters.name: fz_type
parameters.description: Filter by `fz_type`: 1 city-based, 2 industry-based. Omit for all rows.

post.summary:
Find the matching sub-site for a city triplet. PHP `wap/site::domain_action`
is equivalent (it sets a cookie before redirecting; the Rust port returns
the row and lets the client decide). Returns 200 with `null` body when
nothing matches — the client should fall back to the main site.

parameters.name: province_id
parameters.description: PHPYun `provinceid`. Optional but at least one of the three should be set.

post.summary: Send SMS code (call `GET /v1/wap/captcha` first to obtain cid + image)

`wap/special::apply_action`. Requires `usertype=2` (employer); validation
errors return 400 with a stable `param_invalid: <code>` tag (e.g.
`special_signup_closed`, `special_already_applied`, `special_full`,

Upload verification image (5MB) -- company business license / legal representative ID

Upload resume photo (2MB image, jobseeker only)

Required after OAuth registration where `usertype` is left as 0; sets it
to 1/2/3 and seeds the per-role satellite rows. Returns 409 if a role has
already been picked.

Generate a parameterised QR code for a given business resource (mirrors the PHPYun `pubWxQrcode` branch).
`kind` is one of: job / resume / company / article / announcement / jobtel /
        parttel / comtel / part / register / gongzhao

parameters.name: expire
parameters.description: QR code lifetime in seconds (default 7 days; range 60..=2592000)

500.description: Invalid kind, WeChat not configured, or WeChat upstream error

post.summary:
Jobs participating in a recruitment fair. Counterpart of PHP
`app/zph/index::getJobList_action` — loads the job ids signed up for the
fair (`phpyun_zhaopinhui_com.jobid` CSV per company), dedupes, then
returns the live job rows that are still on-shelf (`state=1, r_status=1`).

ActivityItem.description: Personal activity log item — all 9 columns of phpyun_audit_log + formatted timestamp (full uid/ip/ua audit info).

recorded.description:
Whether this click was actually persisted (`false` when the per-IP
rate limit was exceeded — PHP redirects without inserting in that case).

target_url.description:
Target URL the front-end should redirect to (matches PHP
`phpyun_ad.pic_src`). Empty string when the ad row is missing.

image_n.description: Full URL after normalizing `image` (with site / CDN prefix)
Normalized full URL of `image` (with site / CDN prefix)

AidBody.description: Body carrying just `{ aid }` (Q&A answer id).

AnnouncementDetail.description: Announcement detail — Summary + content + formatted-time extensions.

AnnouncementSummary.description: Announcement entry -- fields aligned with the phpyun_announcement table.

is_atn.description: Whether the answer author is followed: 0=no / 1=followed / 2=self

account.description: Account identifier — username / registered email / registered mobile.

ticket_uid.description:
Submitted ticket id (the matched user's uid). Admin reviews via the admin
console; client should display "appeal submitted" and stop polling.

ApplicantSummary.description: Application record item — full 11 columns of phpyun_userid_job + formatted timestamps + derived unread/invited booleans.

eid.description: Resume id (in PHPYun, eid equals the job seeker's uid)

is_browse.description: 1 unviewed / 0 viewed / 3 interviewed / 4 not suitable / 7 hired etc. (PHP polysemous status)

quxiao.description: Whether the job seeker has withdrawn

apply_body.description: Reason for application / description of submitted materials

integral_spent.description: Points deducted from the company's balance (0 if the event was free).

ArticleDetail.description: Article detail — all ArticleSummary fields + content. Field order matches PHP `wap/article::show_action` rendering.

ArticleSummary.description: Article list item — aligned with all fields output by PHP `article.model::getList`.

title_short.description: Truncated title (first 60 chars; PHP has `tlen` parameter to control)

AuthTokenData.description:
Login / refresh / oauth-login response. Returns only the fields the client
needs — `uid`, `usertype`, and the bearer token. The token's `exp` is
already encoded in the JWT payload (base64-decodable), so exposing it
separately just bloats the response. The refresh-token concept is
internal: the server still tracks a paired refresh jti in the session
table for "kick device" semantics, but the client never sees it.

BatchResult.description:
`{ requested, affected }` — bulk-action result envelope. Used by every
admin / employer batch-update / batch-delete endpoint to report how many
items were *requested* (input length) vs. how many were *affected*
(rows the DB actually touched, after auth-scoping and stale filters).

lt_uid.description: Headhunter uid to entrust (target member must have usertype=4).

providers.description: List of bound provider names, e.g. `["google", "apple"]`

cid.description: CAPTCHA cid; send back to the server when submitting registration/login

image.description: Data URI in `data:image/png;base64,...` format; the frontend can render it directly via ``.

CertView.description: Company certification item — all 10 columns of phpyun_company_cert + CDN URL + formatted timestamps + status name.

error.description: 0 = no match, 1 = matched, 2 = sub-site disabled (mirrors PHP `error` field)

ClearResult.description:
`{ removed }` — clear-history result envelope. Used by endpoints that wipe
a user's owned list (search history / blacklist / notification feed) and
report how many rows were dropped.

code.description: Code returned by the third-party callback.

state.description:
State returned by the third-party callback — must match the value
returned by the `authorize-url` endpoint (CSRF protection).

`applied` (already signed up) — see `status` for the application state.
`not_applied` (eligible to apply) — see `jobs` for the picker list.
`no_jobs` (must publish at least one job before applying).

status.description: Only present when `state == "applied"`. 0 pending / 1 approved / 2 rejected.

logo_n.description:
CDN-resolved logo (empty string when the row has no logo). Optional —
PHP returns only `(name, value)`, but the Rust port adds `logo_n` since
many UIs display a tiny logo next to the name.

name.description: Display string for the picker (raw company name).

value.description:
`uid` of the company — pass to `GET /v1/wap/companies/{uid}` to load
the full record.

CompanyDetail.description: Company detail -- strictly mirrors the field set of PHPYun `wap/company::show_action`.

contact.description: Masked contact + `setCompanyLink` codes. Never includes plaintext tel/email.

isatn.description: Whether the current jobseeker follows this company (PHP `isatn`)

userid_job.description: How many times the current jobseeker has applied to this company (PHP `userid_job`)

vip_active.description: Whether VIP is currently active (vipetime > now())

CompanyOpenJob.description: Brief job row for the famous-company hover panel.

CompanyPublicContact.description: Public company contact — same codes as job `setCompanyLink`, no email.

CompanySummary.description:
Company list item — mirrors PHPYun `companyM::getList()` output. Shared
across `wap/companies`, `wap/search`, `wap/home` to keep the card UI
consistent across listing surfaces.

hot_pic.description: Homepage famous-company banner (`phpyun_hotjob.hot_pic`). Absent on regular lists.

job_num.description: Open jobs (`state=1 AND status=0 AND r_status=1`). Additive; 0 when unknown.

open_jobs.description: Homepage famous-company hover (PHP `hotjob` 插件最多 3 条在招).

ContentView.description: Company news/product item — full 10 columns of phpyun_company_news / phpyun_company_product + formatted timestamps + status name.

CountryView.description:
Public-facing country shape. `name` is the localized display name
(zh-CN/zh-TW → `name_zh`, otherwise `name_en`); both raw fields are
also exposed so a client switching language doesn't need a refetch.

minsalary.description: Salary in CNY (yuan); cap to 1M to avoid overflow.

sdate.description: Start date — accepts unix-ts or `"YYYY-MM"` / `"YYYY-MM-DD"` strings.

captcha_cid.description: Image-captcha cid (anti-spam) — required, must be paired with `authcode`.

id.description: Job id (required when posted to the new path-param-free endpoint).

CreatedId.description: `{ id }` — used as the create-result envelope across CRUD endpoints.

default_eid.description:
`phpyun_resume.def_job` — the user's default job-intent id used by
PHP `wap/resume/index::showuid_action` for the legacy short URL.
`0` means the user has no published default intent.

DescDetail.description: Single-page detail -- all 10 columns (including full content) + formatted timestamps.

DictItem.description: Dictionary item as seen by the client. `name` is a string resolved using the current request language.

education.description:
Education-level dict id (PHPYun column `education` — 学历).
PHPYun's frontend posts and reads this as `education` / `education_n`;
the older Rust port called this `title`, accepted as alias for back-compat.
Loose deserializer accepts both `17` (int) and `"17"` (string).

id.description: Optional — only required for the update endpoint.

sdate.description:
Start date — accepts unix-ts or `"YYYY-MM"` / `"YYYY-MM-DD"` strings
(PHPYun date-picker formats; `_n` alias matches the frontend field).

status.description:
Soft delete: pass `2` to delete the entry (equivalent to the original DELETE).
Other values or None go through the update path.

EidBody.description: Body carrying just `{ eid }` (resume-expect id; PHPYun calls this `eid`).

authcode.description: Temporarily optional: image-captcha verification is disabled for this endpoint.

captcha_cid.description: Temporarily optional: image-captcha verification is disabled for this endpoint.

message.description:
Optional personal note from the sender; max 500 chars. PHP composes
this into the email body via the `sendresume.htm` template.

answered.description: Whether the message has been answered.

datetime.description: Unix seconds when the binding was created.

uid.description: Jobseeker uid that bound to me.

ExistsResp.description:
`{ exists }` — boolean probe response. Used by frontend to render a
"follow / favorite / already-applied" button state without leaking the
underlying record id.

ExpectForm.description:
Aligned with PHP `saveexpect_action`. Frontend may send numbers as strings
(`"57"`) or supply `*_classname` text instead of `*_classid` — both are
accepted. Empty / missing numeric fields default to 0.

hy.description: Industry: dict id (large id space, share the dict-id cap).

id.description: Required only on the update endpoint; ignored for create.

job_classid.description:
Job-category id. Optional in JSON; if missing or 0, the server tries
to resolve `job_classname` against the dictionary (fallback for
front-ends that send the human-readable name). Accepts the underscore
form (`job_classid`) and the legacy compact form (`jobclassid`).

salary.description:
PHP table column is `salary`; the front-end UI label is "minsalary"
(the user's expected minimum). We accept either key on the wire.

status.description: Soft delete: pass `2` to delete. Other values or None will trigger an update.

type.description: Work nature: dict id from `phpyun_userclass` (keyid=56, e.g. 57=全职).

fav_count.description: How many of my jobs this user has favorited.

username.description: Username (PHP `phpyun_member.username`); blank if the row was deleted.

page.description:
Body pagination is preferred by the mobile client. Query pagination is
still accepted by `resolve_pagination` for older clients.

FavoriteListItem.description: A relationship row with kind-specific detail.

GalleryView.description: Gallery item — full 5 columns of phpyun_company_show / phpyun_resume_show.

GzDetail.description: Joint recruitment detail -- all Summary fields + body.

GzSummary.description: Joint recruitment list item -- all 11 columns of phpyun_gongzhao + CDN URL + formatted timestamps + tag array.

tag_arr.description: CSV split (commonly used on the PHP list page)

HitsResp.description:
`{ hits }` — view-count response. Used by job-detail / article-detail
"increment + return new value" endpoints.

HomeData.description: Home page aggregated data -- reuses the rich Summary types from each domain to keep field semantics consistent with list / detail pages.

new_articles.description: Reuses `wap::articles::ArticleSummary` (27 fields, includes category name / CDN URL / formatted time)

logo_n.description: CDN-resolved logo URL (alongside the raw column for legacy clients).

sort_mode.description:
0=sort ASC, 1=lastupdate DESC, 2=random — echoed back so the client
can short-cache appropriately.

HotItem.description: Hot search keyword item — all 5 columns of phpyun_hot_search + formatted timestamp.

HrDetail.description: HR document detail -- all fields (including the full body content).

url.description: CDN-resolved download URL the client should redirect to.

HrSummary.description: HR document list item -- all 9 columns of phpyun_hr_doc + body excerpt + formatted timestamps.

body_excerpt.description: First 100 chars of body (PHP list preview)

IdBody.description: Body carrying just `{ id }`. Use for any "act on one resource by id" call.

IdPasswordBody.description:
`{ id, password }` — password-required action (verify / refresh / delete a
short-link or one-shot job by id, where the owner re-enters the password
they set when creating the resource).

IdsBody.description:
Body carrying `{ ids: Vec<u64> }`. Capped at 200 items, each id 1..=10^8.
Used for batch-delete / batch-update endpoints.

InterviewItem.description: Interview invitation item — all 12 columns of `phpyun_interview` + formatted time + status name.

linktel.description: Full number only when PHP `linkCode == 1`; otherwise empty.

JobMsgView.description: Public-facing message item (no internal flags exposed).

plain_text.description:
Plain-text card the user pastes elsewhere. Pre-rendered with
short URL (`share_url`) appended.

summary.description:
`{salary} | {city} | {edu}` — primary one-line summary suitable for
chat / Weibo card. Empty fields are omitted.

JobSummary.description:
Job list item — aligned with the field set returned by PHPYun
`JobM::getList()`. **Shape is shared across `wap`, `mcenter` and `admin`**
so the front-end card component is identical regardless of the listing
context.

edu_n.description:
Education-level name (PHP `comclass` dict, e.g. "本科") —
filled by `job_summary_from_dict*`; empty for `From<Job>`.

exp_n.description:
Experience-tier name (PHP `comclass` dict, e.g. "5-10 年") —
filled by `job_summary_from_dict*`; empty for `From<Job>`.

is_favorited.description:
Whether the *current* user has favorited this job. Always `false` for
unauthenticated requests / non-favorite contexts.

jobname.description: Three-level job category joined as "Frontend / Web Frontend / React Developer" (PHP `jobname`)

newtime.description:
Posted within the last 2 days (PHP `newtime`); requires `now` ts to
derive — `From<Job>` leaves this `false`.

KindTargetIdBody.description: Body carrying `{ kind, target_id }` for favorites / generic kind+id pairs.

KindTargetUidBody.description: Body carrying `{ kind, target_uid }` for follows / ratings / remarks.

LanguageItem.description: Language skill item — all 5 columns of phpyun_resume_language (PHPYun ships this as a stub: writes return 0, reads return empty).

LogItem.description: Assessment history item — all 6 columns of phpyun_eval_log + formatted timestamp.

authcode.description:
Image captcha (PHP field name `authcode`) -- optional.
Only verified when paired with `captcha_cid`; if neither or only one is supplied, verification is skipped (aligned with PHPYun `wap/login::mlogin` behavior).

captcha_cid.description: Image captcha cid (specific to phpyun-rs; PHP uses session) -- optional.

MessageItem.description:
Message item — backed by `phpyun_sysmsg`.

PHP `phpyun_sysmsg` only stores `content` + `usertype` + `remind_status`;
no `category` / `title` / `ref_kind` / `ref_id` columns. We keep those
fields on the DTO (as constants) for backward-compatible response shape:
  - `category` → "system"
  - `title`    → "" (PHP merges title into content at write-time)
  - `ref_kind` → 0 / "none"
  - `ref_id`   → 0

Frontends that ignored these fields keep working; ones that read them
see harmless defaults.

category.description: Always "system" — kept for response-shape stability with old clients.

title.description: Always empty — kept for response-shape stability.

MidBody.description: Body carrying just `{ mid }` (job-page message id).

MyApplySummary.description: My application item — full 11 columns of phpyun_userid_job + formatted timestamps + derived employer_viewed/invited booleans.

employer_viewed.description: Derived: whether the employer has viewed (is_browse == 0)

is_browse.description: 1 unviewed / 0 viewed / 3 interviewed / 4 not suitable / 7 hired

NearCompany.description: Nearby company item -- phpyun_company projection + dict + CDN + derived distance.

NearJob.description: Nearby job item -- phpyun_company_job projection + dict + derived distance + time formatting.

NewsDetail.description: Company news detail — all fields (including full body content).

NewsSummary.description: Company news list item — all phpyun_company_news columns.

body_excerpt.description: First 100 chars of body (used by PHP list preview)

OAuthAuthorizeData.description:
`{ authorize_url, state }` — third-party OAuth start-flow response.
Used identically by every provider (wechat / qq / weibo) to ship the user
off to the provider's consent page.

id_token.description: id_token (JWT) returned from the provider SDK

OkResp.description:
`{ ok }` — generic boolean-success response. Used by claim / oauth-bind /
payment-callback endpoints that just want to signal completion. Prefer
`ApiResponse::message` for the full message-envelope; this struct is for cases where the
frontend explicitly reads `data.ok`.

OrderNoBody.description: Body carrying an order_no string (vip / once payments).

PackageItem.description: VIP package item — all 10 columns of phpyun_vip_package + derived price_yuan (yuan unit).

PaperDetail.description: Assessment detail — all PaperSummary fields + nested questions.

PaperSummary.description: Assessment list item — all 7 columns of phpyun_eval_paper + CDN URL + formatted time.

PartDetail.description: Part-time detail -- aligned with the full field set of PHPYun `wap/part::show_action`.

edate_state.description: 0 long-term / 1 expired / 2 expires within 3 days / 3 expires within 7 days / 4 normal

PartSummary.description:
Part-time list item — aligned with PHP `wap/part::index_action` full-field
output + dict translation + time formatting. Shape is shared between
`wap/part` and `mcenter/part::ComPartSummary`.

is_rec.description: 1 means currently within the pinned period (`rec_time > now`)

state.description: 1 = pending payment (call the gateway), 2 = already paid (free gear).

oncepricegear.description: `phpyun_once_price_gear.id` — the duration package the user picked.

password.description: Posting password (md5-hashed by the server before comparison).

paytype.description:
Gateway tag — `alipay` / `wxpay` / `wxh5` etc. Just a label here; the
downstream gateway endpoint reads it.

ProductDetail.description: Product detail — all fields (including full body content).

ProductSummary.description: Company product list item — all phpyun_company_product columns + CDN URL + formatted time.

sdate.description:
Start date — accepts unix-ts or `"YYYY-MM"` / `"YYYY-MM-DD"` strings
(PHPYun date-picker formats; `_n` alias matches the frontend field).

ProviderBody.description: Body carrying a third-party `provider` slug (oauth bind/unbind).

QuestionDetail.description: Q&A detail -- fields aligned with PHP `wap/ask::content_action`.

is_attention.description: Whether followed (= alias of qatn, for backward compatibility)

is_support.description: Whether liked (PHPYun has no detail table; always 0)

qatn.description: Whether the question is followed: 0/1 (self-asked question is 2)

QuestionSummary.description: Question list item -- aligned with the full set of fields rendered by PHP `wap/ask::list_action`.

content_excerpt.description: Excerpt (first 120 chars of content; the PHP list page also truncates for display)

QuestionView.description: Question view — all 5 columns of phpyun_eval_question (with score field stripped) + paper_id / sort.

options.description: Option list (shaped like `[{label:"A", text:"xxx"}, ...]`; score not returned to prevent cheating)

status.description: 0 = ok, 1 = daily cap reached, 2 = interval too short

QuotePriceBody.description:
Compute the effective price the current user pays for a package.

Counterpart of PHP `ajax::getPackPrice_action` (`kind=pack`) and
`ajax::getVipPrice_action` (`kind=vip`). Combines:
  - rating-tier discount (`service_discount`)
  - active promo window (`time_start < now < time_end`)
  - integral-payment availability (`com_integral_online == 3` and `kind`
    not in `sy_only_price`)
  - the user's integral balance

Returns 403 for non-employers; 400 when the package id is unknown or
`kind` is not `pack` / `vip`.

kind.description: `pack` or `vip` — selects which price table to read.

RatingItem.description: Rating item — all 9 columns of phpyun_rating + formatted timestamps.

RatingSummary.description: Rating aggregate — all 6 columns of phpyun_rating_aggregate + derived `avg` (avg_x100 / 100 as float).

avg.description: Float average (avg_x100 / 100, convenient for directly rendering 4.5★)

has_children.description: Whether this node has any active children. Saves the client a second round trip.

name.description: Translated name following the request's language with fallback chain.

captcha_cid.description: Image captcha cid (returned by GET /v1/wap/captcha; PHPYun uses session, we use Redis)

moblie.description:
Mobile number (PHPYun legacy field name `moblie`; DB column same).
Required only on the mobile-registration path (`regway=2`); the
service layer enforces presence + format when that path is selected.
Aligns with PHP `register.model.php::regMoblie` which gates on
`isset($post['moblie'])` rather than presence.

moblie_code.description:
SMS code (PHP calls this `moblie_code`). Empty when registering by
username; the service layer rejects empty when `regway=2`.

referrer_uid.description: Referrer uid (aligned with the `uid` parameter on PHPYun invite links); 0 = no referrer

regway.description:
Registration method (PHP `regway`): 1=username / 2=mobile / 3=email.
The current Rust implementation enforces uniqueness across all fields; this field is kept only for audit records.

usertype.description:
1 = jobseeker (default), 2 = company, 3 = campus.
Loose deserializer accepts both `1` (int) and `"1"` (string) — PHPYun
frontends serialise every numeric form field as a string.

code.description: Pass this value as `reason_code` when submitting a report.

moblie_code.description: SMS verification code, PHP field name `moblie_code`

ResumeDetail.description: Resume detail — strictly aligned with the field set of PHPYun `wap/resume::show_action`.

m_status.description: PHP `$Info.m_status`: 1 = self or company that already downloaded.

resume_check.description: PHP `$resumeCkeck`: 1 = full experience body, 2 = summary only.

resume_open_check.description: Site config `resume_open_check` (1–4) for the front-end look-all branch.

status.description: 1=public / 2=hidden / 3=visible only to companies the user has applied to

job_class_n.description: Job class name (dict resolve_job; takes the first numeric id)

ResumeSummary.description:
Resume list item — aligned with all fields of the PHP resume search page. Masking rules are decided by the service layer (nametype).

Field grouping:
- Identity basics: uid / display_name / sex / age / marriage / nationality
- Residence: living / domicile (address never serialized on list)
- Education / experience: education / education_n / exp / exp_n
- Photos: photo / photo_n / has_photo / resume_photo / phototype
- Verification badges: idcard_status / moblie_status / email_status
- Contact: tag / label / retire (`qq` / `wxewm` / `homepage` never serialized)
- Time: lastupdate / lastupdate_n / resumetime / login_date

display_name.description: Display-safe name after masking based on nametype

expect_city_n.description: Default expect city display name. Additive.

expect_name.description: Default expect job title (PHP list `$user.name`). Additive.

expect_salary_n.description: Default expect salary dict name (PHP list `$user.salary_n`). Additive.

articles.description: Reuses wap::articles::ArticleSummary (29 fields, with class names / CDN / formatted timestamps)

companies.description: Reuses wap::companies::CompanySummary (18 fields, with dictionary translations)

jobs.description: Reuses wap::jobs::JobSummary (34 fields, with dictionary translations)

captcha_cid.description:
Image captcha cid — required (anti-bombing / anti-enumeration), same
scheme as the SMS path.
Image captcha cid -- required (prevents SMS bombing / phone number enumeration)

SettingsListBody.description:
List public settings, or return selectable report reasons when
`key=report_reasons`.

key.description: Empty = all public settings. `report_reasons` returns report-reason options.

active.description: Derived: not revoked and not expired

captcha_cid.description: Image captcha cid — required (anti SMS-bombing / mobile-enumeration)

scene.description: `register` / `login` / `reset_pw` (added in phpyun-rs; PHP splits into multiple separate actions, we merge them into one endpoint distinguished by scene)

SpecialCompanyItem.description: Participating company item — all 6 columns of phpyun_special_company + joined company info (name/logo/hy/pr/mun/city).

SpecialSummary.description: Special list item — aligned with all 20 columns of phpyun_special + CDN URL + formatted timestamps.

StatusFilterBody.description:
`{ status: Option<i32> }` — admin list filter envelope. The 0..=99 bound is
permissive on purpose; handlers further interpret the value (0=pending,
1=approved, ...) via service logic.
PHP pages send `status: ""` or `"0"`; reject those as i32 → HTTP 400.

domain.description:
Hostname (no scheme). Front-end is expected to prepend its current
scheme (`https://`) when redirecting.

following.description: New state after toggle: true = now following, false = now unfollowed.

TokenBody.description: Body carrying an opaque token (resume-share, password-reset, etc.).

TplItem.description: Interview template item — all 11 columns of `phpyun_interview_template` + formatted time.

UidBody.description:
Body carrying just `{ uid }`. Use for endpoints whose primary subject is a
member uid (resume / company profile / favorited target).

UidIdBody.description: Body carrying `{ uid, id }` (e.g. company sub-page detail).

lt_uid.description: Either `lt_uid` (preferred) OR `id` (the entrust row id) — at least one required.

UnreadCount.description:
`{ unread }` — unread badge response. Used by every notification channel
(broadcasts / warnings / messages) to drive the bell icon counter.

messages.description: `phpyun_sysmsg` (system messages, the legacy table the message centre reads).

total.description: Sum of all four — the number to badge on the bell icon.

warnings.description: `phpyun_warning` risk-control warnings shown to the user.

sdate.description:
Start date — accepts unix-ts or `"YYYY-MM"` / `"YYYY-MM-DD"`. `None`
when omitted by the client (partial update leaves DB column untouched).

birthday.description:
PHPYun stores `birthday` as a `YYYY-MM` string (year-month), e.g.
`"1995-06"` — the legacy length-min=8 validator rejected that and
fired silent 400s on the H5 wizard. Min 7 covers `YYYY-MM`,
max 10 keeps `YYYY-MM-DD` working.

nametype.description:
Loose deserializer accepts both `1` and `"1"` — PHPYun frontend
serialises every numeric form field as a string. Same pattern for
all `Option<i32>` siblings below.

key.description: Storage key (saved into the corresponding DB column)

token.description:
Hex token from the email link. Validated as 32..=128 hex chars at the
extractor; the service does the actual lookup + expiration check.

Hex share token issued by `POST /v1/mcenter/resume-share`. Length /
charset is checked here; the service does the actual lookup.

ViewItem.description: View footprint item — all 5 columns of phpyun_view + time formatting + kind name.

pic_n.description: Current logged-in user's avatar (returns default when not logged in)

code.description: Code returned by the WeChat callback

state.description: State returned by the WeChat callback -- must match the state returned by `authorize-url` (OAuth CSRF protection)

sdate.description:
Start date. Accepts unix timestamp (i64), or PHPYun-shaped strings
`"YYYY-MM"` / `"YYYY-MM-DD"` / `"YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS"` (the date-picker
formats every PHPYun frontend ships). The `_n` alias lets the frontend
keep its existing field name `sdate_n`.

status.description: Soft delete: pass `2` to delete. Other values or None perform an update.

ZphCompanyItem.description: Participating-company item -- all phpyun_zph_company columns + JOIN of company basic info (name/logo/hy/pr/mun/city).

ZphDetail.description: Job-fair detail -- mirrors the full field set of PHPYun `wap/zph::show_action` + dict + CDN + formatted timestamps.

ZphSummary.description: Job-fair list item -- mirrors all phpyun_zhaopinhui columns + city name + CDN URL + formatted timestamps.
